To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have developed an efficient algorithm for the classification of remote sensing images that is based on an incremental learning approach and that can be used for the monitoring of geographical areas in a periodic basis.

the proposed classifier is able to learn new knowledge from the environment in an incremental manner, while preserving the knowledge that was previously acquired, and that it is able to perform well in the recognition of remote sensing images.
the proposed method is able to classify the images with high accuracy, even with small training sets.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of an incremental learning RBF classifier for the classification of remote sensing images.
the design of a classifier able to perform an incremental learning in a supervised environment.
the development of a new incremental learning classifier for RS imagery.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed incremental classifier is able to learn new classes without forgetting the previously acquired knowledge.
the proposed incremental learning RBF neural network is able to provide accurate results when applied to remote sensing images.

the proposed classifier is able to perform a reliable classification of remote sensing images, while allowing a periodical update of the classification model, thus allowing the monitoring of the geographical region of interest.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed classifier is able to learn new information from the environment and to adapt to it, while preserving the knowledge already acquired.
we propose an algorithm to learn a classifier for a new class by using only a small amount of training examples, while preserving the previously learnt knowledge.
the proposed classifier is able to learn from a new training set without losing the knowledge learned from previous training sets, thus allowing the incremental learning of a classifier.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the presented classifier is able to learn from a small set of training data and to incrementally update its knowledge when new data is available, without suffering from a significant loss of accuracy.

a classifier that is trained on data from a single time instant is not able to generalize to data from different time instants, and therefore, it is necessary to train a new classifier for each new time instant.

the proposed incremental learning RBF classifier can be successfully used to classify remote sensing images, and the results obtained with the classifier are comparable to the ones obtained with the most popular remote sensing image classification methods.
